figures.name: hero
figures.claim: The network fits in 200 steps and generalises 27,600 steps later.

figures.name: reproduction
figures.claim: Both architectures and both recipes grok; the null does not.

figures.name: signature
figures.claim: Normalised, the reference regime rises cleanly; the canonical regime has nothing to clean.

figures.name: diagrams
figures.claim: One long-lived cycle separates from the diagonal and stays separated.

figures.name: robustness
figures.claim: Five of sixteen conditions clear the null; one runs below it.

figures.name: circularity
figures.claim: Circularity predicts the signature; generalisation does not.

figures.name: torus
figures.claim: The joint representation is a torus upstream and a circle at the readout.

figures.name: basis
figures.claim: The circle is there under multiplication; the residue basis cannot see it.

figures.name: noncyclic
figures.claim: S5 groks with a huge seed spread, and the signature is present anyway.

figures.name: headtohead
figures.claim: Topology adds little over the cheap baselines, and nothing to timing.

figures.name: pid
figures.claim: What topology says about the transition is mostly said by Fourier too.

figures.name: lag
figures.claim: Topology follows generalisation, and leads nowhere.

figures.name: interventions
figures.claim: The interventions work on one architecture and destabilise the other.

figures.name: crocker
figures.claim: The band of live features slides as the cloud contracts.

figures.name: velocity
figures.claim: The representation reorganises fastest around the transition.

figures.name: phdim
figures.claim: The geometry of the search turns after the network begins to generalise.

figures.name: depth
figures.claim: The torus appears at the operand layer, and only after the transition.
